description: Static macro calendar for crypto-macro.get_macro_calendar. Dates in America/New_York local time (time_et). 'confirmed': false = estimated or not verified against the official source — re-check before trading around it. Deribit option expiries are computed in code (last Friday 08:00 UTC), not stored here.
maintenance: Update yearly: add next year's FOMC schedule (published ~September) and BLS schedule (published ~October); flip confirmed=true once checked.
